shingle: A person kneels on one knee on a sloped wooden roof, pulls out a broken shingle with the left hand, slides a new one into place and hammers two nails into it with the right hand.
nailboard: A person kneels on the floor, presses a loose floor board down with the left hand and hammers nails into it with a hammer in the right hand, then checks it with the palm.
patchwall: A person stands at a wall, holds a short plank flat against the wall with the left hand at chest height and hammers nails into its corners with the right hand.
ropeknot: A person crouches at the edge of a platform and tightens the knots of a rope ladder, pulling the rope hard with both hands, then tugs it to test it.
oilhinge: A person bends slightly at a door, holds an oil can in the right hand and squirts oil onto the hinges, then swings the door back and forth with the left hand to test it.
window: A person stands at a window and presses putty along the edges of the glass with the right thumb, smoothing it carefully, then wipes the glass with a cloth.
railing: A person stands at a wooden railing, shakes it with both hands to test it, then hammers a nail into the post with the right hand and shakes it again.
clearleaves: A person crouches on a flat roof and sweeps fallen leaves off it with both hands in wide brushing motions, then throws a handful over the edge.
chimney: A person stands at a stove pipe, reaches up and pushes a long brush up and down inside it with both hands, then taps the pipe and wipes the hands.
tightenrope: A person stands at a rope ladder hanging from a platform, grabs the rope and pulls it hard twice to test it, nods.
